summary: Iter 34 UI regression pass after global MicroInteractions injection, animated mesh backgrounds, Salon Finder, and dual PWA manifests. Result: ALL requested flows GREEN. MicroInteractions ripple/magnet works and DOES NOT break onClick handlers for real users; verified profile dropdown, appointment modal, POS buttons, sidebar nav, hamburger, salon-card click, and find-salon-link all fire correctly. Backend /api/public/salons returns array + filters by q=. Manifest switching correct on /login (manifest-admin.json / Miracurl) and /book/miracurl-marathahalli (manifest.json / M). Dashboard top-bar has no location subtitle (only page title 'Dashboard'). All 11 admin pages (Appointments, CRM, Staff, Attendance, Services, Inventory, POS, Reviews, Referrals, Reports, Settings) load with .app-canvas mesh background. Public /book/miracurl-marathahalli shows .mesh-dark background. Staff login lands on /staff-portal with Check In / Check Out buttons visible. Mobile 390x844: hamburger opens sidebar (translate to left=0) and backdrop click closes it (left=-280).

issues: Repeating console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Non-fatal — charts still render after container measurement completes. Consider adding minHeight to ResponsiveContainer wrappers on Dashboard/Reports.
React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — likely a <span> being rendered inside <option> in a customer/staff select. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add minHeight to Recharts ResponsiveContainer to remove width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on dashboard charts.
OPTIONAL: Fix hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' visible on /appointments (some select renders spans inside <option> for badges/pills).

NOTE for future Playwright tests: prefer page.click(selector) WITHOUT force=True on buttons wrapped by MicroInteractions. force=True combined with fast page.mouse.down/up can bypass the actionability wait and the synthesized click may not reach React's onClick. Regular page.click() works reliably (verified profile-menu-btn and add-appointment-btn).
critical_code_review_comments: MicroInteractions.jsx pointerdown handler correctly registered as passive (line 83), so it cannot preventDefault or block clicks — verified real clicks fire onClick handlers normally.

MicroInteractions.jsx line 78 (el.appendChild(wrap)) inserts ripple <span> during pointerdown. Both wrapper and dot have pointer-events:none in index.css line 278-280, so hit-testing for pointerup is not affected — good.

ManifestSwitcher correctly toggles link[rel=manifest] href and meta apple-mobile-web-app-title based on route. /login and admin routes → manifest-admin.json + 'Miracurl'; /book and /book/:slug → manifest.json + 'M'. Verified live.
Backend GET /api/public/salons returns array [{slug,name,location,hero_image}] and correctly filters by q= (Mongo case-insensitive regex on name/location/slug). No _id leakage.
SalonFinder.jsx correctly wires salon-search-input, salon-card-<slug>, and empty state text 'No salons found'.
BookPublic.jsx correctly exposes find-salon-link testid and applies white-label morph via /public/salons/:slug (verified header shows 'Miracurl Unisex Family Salon').

seed_data_creation: None. No test data created — only navigated/read-only flows tested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MicroInteractions is safe — no click regression for real user interactions. When writing Playwright tests against buttons in this app, use `await page.click(selector)` WITHOUT force=True. If using force=True, add ~500ms wait before clicks in header/toolbar to let magnet/ripple listeners attach and any transient toasts dismiss. All key data-testids used this session: profile-menu-btn, profile-signout-btn, profile-install-app-btn, sidebar-open-btn, app-sidebar, sidebar-backdrop, add-appointment-btn, salon-search-input, salon-card-miracurl-marathahalli, find-salon-link, public-book-page. Manifest switching is real — check document.querySelector('link[rel=manifest]').href to verify.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found. Initial false-negatives during automation were caused by test-harness issues (force=True + low-level mouse.down/up bypassing MicroInteractions' passive pointerdown timing), not app bugs. Verified with normal page.click(): profile dropdown opens (signout btn count 0→1) and appointment modal opens (dialog visible in screenshot).
